method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; answers are enumerations worded under the 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 rulings on negatives; one regulative rule (ss 68, 168) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts and dates; no REFUSE (a claim in a State or Territory court answers `not covered`, asserted); every court finding or discretion asked as an input; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. A second encoding beside baseline-2026-10 (the accused's seat), which is untouched. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Evidence Act 1995, the compilation registered as C2025C00340 (Compilation No. 35, compilation date 2025-06-10; Federal Register of Legislation, retrieved 2026-10-13), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A04858.txt. No instrument brought in.

focus: the provisions a person bringing a civil claim meets

Out: Chapter 2; ss 61, 65, 66, 70-75; Part 3.4 admissions; Parts 3.7-3.9; s 120(2), ss 126A-128A; public interest immunity; ss 137-139, 141, 142; the rest of Chapter 4; s 190(2), ss 192, 192A, 185-187.
